0022600179.text: The Utah Jazz (1-6, on a five-game losing streak and 14th in the West) are on the road against the New Orleans Pelicans (3-4, on a three-game winning streak and 11th in the West) in the Jazz's eighth game of the 2026-27 season. Jaren Jackson Jr., Jusuf Nurkic and Trey Alexander are out for Utah, Mo Bamba is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision, and Jordan Poole, Trey Murphy III and Yves Missi are out for New Orleans. Utah leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 120-119 win in Salt Lake City on 2026-10-23, and the Jazz were swept 0-3 by the Pelicans in 2025-26.
